signs.pattern: [Frontend] Always use camelCase in React props, API responses use snake_case
[Backend] Use Django REST Framework serializers for API endpoints
Always use docker compose exec -T for non-interactive commands
[Backend] Test steps for services/* imports must use 'python manage.py shell -c' not 'python -c' due to Django app dependencies
NEVER hardcode AI model names (gpt-4, claude-3, gemini, - always use environment variables or settings
